courses.title: Self-Care Mastery
courses.description: A self-paced course in five modules, with fifteen short videos from Cynthia, worksheets and guided meditations on purpose, health, money and relationships. It moves from looking honestly at present habits and self-imposed limits to a written plan for daily self-care.

courses.title: Freedom Coach Training
courses.description: A six-month certification for people who already coach or counsel, teaching the emotional integration methods Cynthia developed. It runs from an online weekend intensive through seven weekly evening lessons, mentoring with a certified Freedom Coach and a closing session with her.
